    @staticmethod
    def isvalid(version):
        """Check if the version string is a valid semantic version string.

        :param version: version string
        :return: True if the version string is valid, False otherwise
        :rtype: bool

        >>> semver.VersionInfo.isvalid('1.2.3')
        True
        >>> semver.VersionInfo.isvalid('01.2.3')
        False
        """
        return isvalid(version)
